page.text:
Sometimes theorems have results that are true if and only if certain
assumptions are true. Mathlingua supports this with the optional `iff:`
section as follows:

```mlg
Theorem:
given: A, B is \set
then: A = B
iff:
. A \:subset?:/ B
. B \:subset?:/ A
Id: "d3ee9362-d0be-47f0-bf0e-ecea7416d100"
```

Another aspect to notice here is that we can write `A, B is \set` instead
of
```mlg-fragment
given:
. A is \set
. B is \set
```
although specifying `A` and `B` is valid syntax too.
